text:
By Annie O'Sullivan ,
1 hours ago
TheStreet aims to feature only the best products and services. If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission.
Why we love this deal The frustrating thing about shoes is that they are an item that can be so tricky to store. You can spend years building up a collection of classics, but without enough storage space, your favorite sneakers, sandals, and heels can deteriorate in quality. And with the high cost of shoes these days, that's an end result no one wants. Closet space is already limited, but with proper organizers, you can keep all kinds of kicks in top condition, and actually be able to find the pair you're looking for when you're getting dressed.
As part of Walmart's October Deals event , the Bgtrend 9-Tier Shoe Rack is on sale for 54% off. Right now, you can purchase the shoe organizer, which originally retails for $70, for just $32.
Bgtrend 9-Tier Shoe Rack, $32 (was $70) at Walmart Why do shoppers love it? This tiered rack gives you a space to store all types of shoes in an aesthetically-pleasing shelved organizer. With nine shelves divided up into three columns, there are more than 27 different storage spaces for your flats, slippers, sneakers, and any other shoe you could think of. The adjustable shelves help accommodate between 50-55 pairs of shoes of varying heights, so even your knee-high boots can find a place to sit securely in between wears. The shelves and removable hooks also provide the opportunity to store bags, clutches, umbrellas, and other apparel pieces and accessories.
And that's not the only customizable part. Although designed to stand in three even columns, which in that specific set up measures 10 inches long, 50.4 inches wide, and 62 inches high, you can build the shoe racks in a DIY way that accommodates your needs or space. Made of surface-coated metal tubes with plastic connectors, the rack can be assembled in no time, and provides a sturdy base to store the heaviest shoes and bags, or even toolboxes and other miscellaneous items. Use it in a closet entryway, hallway, bedroom, or even garage to help with the piles of clutter that easily accumulate throughout and overwhelm your home.
Related: Walmart is selling a $50 portable charger for just $20, and customers love how quickly it can charge a phone
Available in two different colors, this shoe rack is the space-saving storage hack that's stylish enough to match your existing furniture and decor.
Details to know Colors: Two. Dimensions: The show rack measures 10 inches long, 50.4 inches wide, and 62 inches high. Capacity: The rack can hold between 50-55 pairs of shoes. Material: Metal and plastic. Shoppers were impressed with how sturdy the shoe rack ended up being, with no wiggling or wobbling when placing or removing shoes and other items. They love how it can hold such a large collection of shoes without taking up too much space, and that the instructions actually show you various ways you can set up the shoe rack to accommodate different spaces. "A sturdy space saver that is packed with functionality and durability," one shopper said.
Shop more deals You might not consider a shoe rack as an essential for your home, but when you see how well they can organize the shoe piles at the bottom of your closet, you'll be quick to add the Bgtrend 9-Tier Shoe Rack to your cart.
